targets: Zero accepted frame/body/time-basis mix-ups in the frozen negative-control corpus.
Zero false independence decisions for known common-mode cases.
Zero premature healthy-state re-entry in the frozen synthetic recovery corpus.
Empirical uncertainty-region coverage consistent with declared confidence and assumptions.

At matched operating point, pursue at least 20% reduction in p95 trajectory error or unqualified-position exposure on one preregistered transition profile without worsening false alarms or false-safe exposure.
100% of decision-relevant outputs bind exact input/configuration/profile/transform/time/evidence/oracle references or return INDETERMINATE.
100% byte-reproducible replay of the frozen synthetic corpus.

split_policy: Group by complete recording, route, site, session, receiver/device, campaign and environmental condition.
Do not place overlapping windows from one trajectory across train/validation/test.
Freeze split manifest and benchmark subject before final evaluation.
Declare public-test exposure and previous tuning use; do not label exposed tests as pristine blind evidence.
prerequisites_before_preregistration: Expand to at least 12–20 frozen episodes including positive controls.
Implement semantic validation beyond JSON Schema.
Complete external dataset rights, version, calibration and ground-truth audits.
Pin matched classical and benchmark-native baselines.
Review the exact Symtropy model-capability path; unsupported physics stays abstract or unknown.
